probe_detail.name: Uses numbered or bulleted list structure
Justifies the step a reader is most likely to doubt
Identifies the actual error in the asker's approach

final.name: Notation carries the argument, judged independently of typesetting
final.audit_justification: Measures whether symbols are introduced and used consistently so the argument can actually be followed, which bears on the substance of the mathematical communication rather than its typesetting.

final.name: Every load-bearing step supplied, once, nothing restated
final.audit_justification: Directly assesses whether the load-bearing mathematical steps are supplied and justified exactly once, a core substantive-rigor property.

final.name: Extent of verbatim echo and attribution of asker's material
final.audit_justification: Counts the sheer extent of quoting/attribution as a textual habit rather than judging the mathematics, though answerers who closely quote the asker's work may also be the ones engaged enough to spot the actual error.
final.upstream_parent: Direct engagement with asker's specific work

final.name: LLM-Style Templated Boilerplate
final.audit_justification: Flags a generic AI-style phrasing fingerprint independent of correctness, though the underlying LLM authorship this detects could also plausibly produce genuinely more complete or correct content.

final.name: Extent of from-scratch setup in the opening lines
final.audit_justification: Measures how much of the opening is spent on scene-setting or restatement as a pacing habit, explicitly without judging whether that orientation is helpful, necessary, or well written.
final.upstream_parent: Presupposes or names sibling answers on this question

final.name: Lands the exact object asked, fully specialised to it
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the argument is actually carried through and specialised to the specific object asked rather than left generic, a substantive completeness property.

final.name: Extent of LaTeX machinery versus ASCII mathematical orthography
final.audit_justification: Measures typesetting/markup density versus plain ASCII orthography, an explicitly cosmetic dimension the prompt separates from whether the mathematics is right.
final.upstream_parent: Site-markup fluency versus plaintext ASCII mathematical orthography

final.name: Extent of second-person address, reassurance and imperative coaching
final.audit_justification: Counts second-person coaching, reassurance, and imperative language as an interpersonal-tone marker, though a more engaged, patient explainer might also be somewhat more likely to spell out genuine justifications elsewhere in the answer.

final.name: Route choice named and mathematically motivated in context
final.audit_justification: Requires a stated, mathematically real reason for the chosen method rather than a bare signpost word, which is substantive evidence about the quality of the argument.

final.name: Names a specific pitfall and explains why it fails
final.audit_justification: Requires the mechanism of a specific mathematical failure mode to be named and explained, a substantive content property independent of tone or warmth.

final.name: Extent of sheer text volume, elaboration and repeated exposition
final.audit_justification: Measures raw length, elaboration, and repetition as a volume metric, though greater elaboration could sometimes reflect genuinely more complete coverage of needed steps rather than pure padding.

final.name: Scope posture: fragment or supplement versus whole solution
final.audit_justification: Scores only the rhetorical framing of scope (fragment/hint versus complete solution) as stated in the text, not whether that scope choice is appropriate or the content within it is good.
final.upstream_parent: Presupposes or names sibling answers on this question
